final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), ''), '(no recorded pattern)') AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), ''), '(no recorded pattern)')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, o.mean_avg FROM group_averages g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_igg > o.mean_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg, k.avg_igg - k.mean_avg AS above_group_mean, k.avg_igg - m.mean_kept AS from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY k.pattern
